title: Late fees on enterprise invoices
lastQuestion: Which of them can ship first?

context.label: Late fee shown twice on the PDF

turns.question: Split the pinned epic into stories, in the order they should be delivered.
turns.answer:
I read PROJ-120, the meeting topic and `web/src/billing/pdf.ts`. Two stories, in this order:

1. **Charge the fee** first, since the PDF has nothing to show until then.
2. **Show it on the PDF**.

The defect PROJ-456 looks like the same code path; I flagged it.

story.title: Charge late fees on overdue enterprise invoices
story.want: overdue enterprise invoices to carry a late fee I approve
story.soThat: customers pay on time and we stop chasing them by hand
acceptanceCriteria: Only enterprise accounts get a late fee.
The fee is 1.5% per month, capped at 10% of the invoice.

flags.label: Needs a backend change
flags.evidence: web/src/billing/fees.ts has no rate per plan

story.title: Show the late fee on the invoice PDF
story.want: the late fee as its own line on the invoice PDF
story.soThat: customers see why they pay more
acceptanceCriteria: The PDF shows the fee as its own line, with the rate.
Invoices without a fee look as they do today.

flags.label: Touches the defect PROJ-456
flags.evidence: web/src/billing/pdf.ts:41 adds the fee line twice

topic.title: Waivers for late fees
topic.note: Who may waive a fee, and up to how much? Decide before the first story ships.

questions.text: Should the fee show on invoices already sent?

options.label: Only new ones
options.detail: Sent PDFs stay as they were.

turns.question: Which of them can ship first?
turns.liveText: The fee itself can ship first: the PDF story needs
